params.afterRegistry: URI fragment between registry address and token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params.tokenId: The token ID in the registry.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

AFTER_REGISTRY().notice: URI fragment between registry address and token.

userdoc.notice: An immutable IRegistryURIRenderer that injects registry address and token ID into a URI string using fragments.  Ownable for contract naming. The registry address does not include "0x". Format: "{PREFIX}{registryAsHexAddress}{AFTER_REGISTRY}{tokenIdAsDecimal}{AFTER_TOKEN}" eg.       PREFIX = "https://metadata/0x"   AFTER_REGISTRY = "/"      AFTER_TOKEN = ".json" renderURI(1, 2) => "https://metadata/0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001/2.json"
